reviews.t: Beautiful fan brush that performs perfectly!
reviews.x: I was looking for a brush small enough to put just a hint of highlighter on my cheeks, however I didn’t want to pay an arm and a leg for it. Finally, I came upon this little fan brush and decided for the price, I would give it a try.  The brush arrived much sooner than I had anticipated which was a nice surprise. It arrived in perfect condition with all the bristles exactly where they should have been. When I lightly dusted it across my highlighter and brushed it over my cheeks, the brush deposi

It's my now go to highlighting fan brush over my morphe one. Such a pretty brush. I was pretty impressed by the quality. For the price, this is actually really good. I would actually recommend this to those who are in need of a good quality brush for a very good price.

Good quality. Great price. The brush does the job. I was surprise how fast was delivered  considering  it came from China. I would recommend it.  The wrapping was horrible it did not bring the plastic that protects the brush therefore the bristles were smashed in wrong direction. I hope they recover the shape after washing it.

This product is great and it helps the the price is wonderful!  I bought three!!  Arrived way before the suggested time, and I am an impatient one decided I could wait.  Supposed to get to me late July early August, I received yesterday July 5.  Packaged great.  I did wash first and they dried perfect and perform to my standards.  Thanks Amazon for making all products available!

I really really love this brush. absolutely nothing wrong with it at all. and for the price it's a steal! it picks up the perfect amount of product to highlight your checks with and put on blush or even contour with. none of the bristles come out and they're extremely soft and well made. I'll be purchasing aagain when this one gets old. you won't regret buying this I promise.

This brush is whack... It's not a good fan brush and the funny part about it is that IT PICKS UP NO MAKEUP.. It's so bad that I gave it to May daughter to use for her barbie house as a barbie broom  DO NOT BUY THIS IN HOPES OF A GOOD FAN BRUSH... Just go to target please

reviews.t: The price makes this brush even better
reviews.x: I bought this brush as a gift for a friend, who has huge standards for makeup and brushes alike, and she has absolutely no complaints.  Packaging: This fan brush comes with a thick, yet flexible and soft, plastic cover that easily slips on and off the bristles and is generously wrapped in bubble wrap and tucked inside the standard plastic shipping package.  The product itself: The brush handle is long, but not so much that it gets in the way. The bristles are shiny and super soft and I've heard

reviews.t: This is a great brush can be used for makeup or your nails
reviews.x: This is a great brush can be used for makeup or your nails. Great uses are for highlighter or dusting away fine dust or glitter when doing your nails. Soft and portable, easy use and a great addition to a brush collect. This is a definite must have.
Came completely misshapen even after a number of times washing it I couldn't reshape it. It also hardly picks up any product, it's worthless, threw it away.
Honestly the smell of the brush throws me off the most. I don't know if I would recommend this. Great price BUT. Mine sheds and smells awful
The brush was super cheap and I love that but it came all deformed looking like it had a bad hair day.
Works perfect for a great highlight! Picks up the perfect amount of product. No shedding or anything
Not really what I imagined, The bristles are long and flimsy and it doesn't pick up much product
Great product, great price, comes quickly, what more could you ask for?
I've been wanting one of this and I am excited to use it! 😍

reviews.t: I guess you get what you pay for
reviews.x: The brush I received looked nothing like the picture, it was flimsy and sparse and when it arrived some of the bristles were sticking out funny. It was less than $4 with shipping so I can't be bothered to send it back, but based off of the reviews it's pretty much a gamble whether you'll get a good product out of this one. They seem to be sending out two different brushes. Mine was crap.

I was so excited to receive this brush. However, it didn't really meet my expectations. First, it took about 2 months ti recieve. Second, when I did recieve it, the brush part was all bent. I thought that if I washed it maybe it would go back to normal. It didn't. Lastly, the metal part that connects to the wood part was not really glued on well and feels like it will fall off.

This is a really great brush for the price. I was a little skeptical due to the mixture of good and bad reviews, but I took my chance anyway to see if I was one of the ones that received a good brush, and I was.  My brush came in very good condition with all of the bristles attached and not bent. This brush works great to apply my highlighter evenly. I love it.

I really like this brush, it's seriously the *perfect* hilight brush. It picks up just the right amount of product, and diffuses it beautifully. You can use it for a very natural look, or use it to build up product. Also useful for whisking away fallout from powdery or glittery eyeshadows without smearing it under the eye. I love this brush.

reviews.t: It does the job, but it's very flimsy and ...
reviews.x: It does the job, but it's very flimsy and doesn't apply product nearly as well as thicker brushes I've tried. The bristles are not as straight as they look in the picture, they tend to bend on the sides. Cheap plastic, and cheap hair. But, overall okay product for what you're paying.

reviews.t: I accidentally bought two but honestly the brush is good especially for that price
reviews.x: I accidentally bought two but honestly the brush is good especially for that price. It took awhile to come but it did come before the actual delivery date. It doesn't shed at least for me it didn't so I would say you should buy it if it's your first time trying out a fan brush.

reviews.t: which is great! I love how soft this brush is
reviews.x: This came way earlier than it was expected too, which is great! I love how soft this brush is. My only criticism is that the ends of the brush had stray hairs. But, I'm sure I can just trim those away. I haven't used this brush yet, but so far it looks pretty good.

WOW. Shipping was SO QUICK. I was suppose to get this October 3rd by the latest, it is a MONTH EARLY. Amazing. The price was good so I figured I had nothing to lose by buying it. A few of the bristles where out of shape and bent but it still works good. I'm happy.

reviews.t: The brush is really nice and sturdy
reviews.x: The brush is really nice and sturdy. It is really soft and I haven't seen any shedding. However when I got mine there was no plastic cover on the  Bristles So a couple of them where bent and I can't get them to go straight again. Other then that, is great quality.

reviews.t: ... expect that brush would be so mush of a good quality based on price
reviews.x: I didn't even expect that brush would be so mush of a good quality based on price, but surprisingly it is. Works perfectly on a face and it's great for making everiday and/or special occasion look. i'm happy with this purchase :)

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the brush as a great value for the low price.
Many customers say it picks up the right amount of product and works well for highlighting.
Several reviewers report the brush arrived misshapen or deformed, sometimes due to poor packaging.
Some customers complain the bristles are flimsy or that it hardly picks up any product.
A few reviewers mention shedding or an unpleasant smell.
